commits.message:
feat: emit machine-readable lint inventory via --list-lints

Adds a versioned, machine-readable inventory of all registered lints
that can be emitted via `cargo cost-lint --list-lints --format json`.

The inventory is generated at build time by build.rs, which parses
soroban_cost_lints/src/lib.rs to extract lint declarations and
metadata from LINT_METADATA. It produces a JSON object with:

- version: inventory schema version ("1.0")
- schema: URL pointing to schema documentation
- lints: array of entries with name, default_level, description,
  category, and documentation_url

Consumes the registry from register_lints without creating a
cross-crate dependency cycle. The generated code is emitted into
OUT_DIR as lint_metadata.rs and include!d by the CLI binary.

Adds unit test lint_metadata_matches_registered_lints verifying
the inventory matches all registered lints, plus integration tests
for JSON and text output of --list-lints.

Closes #118

chore: fill in publishable metadata on cargo-cost-lint manifest

Adds description, repository, readme, keywords, and categories to
cargo-cost-lint/Cargo.toml so the crate can be published to crates.io
without metadata errors.

- description: a one-line summary of the tool's purpose
- repository: points to the upstream repo
- readme: points to the workspace README
- keywords: soroban, stellar, wasm, linter, cost, cargo
- categories: development-tools:cargo-plugins
- license already present (Apache-2.0)

Closes #88
